title: looking for amateur game devs
author: Stunning_Can_2785
selftext:
Heya! I'm a design university student currently conducting research on the use of AI in game character design. This research is aimed at amateur game developers, whether you're currently studying game development in college/university, self-learning, or pursuing it as a hobby!

My team and I have put together a survey for this research, and we'd really appreciate your participation. If you're interested in taking part, feel free to drop a reply below and I'll DM you the survey link! Please make sure your DMs are open as well. Thank you! (´∀\`)
